Gideon, the earliest report I can find in #inc-vtg-hartford is your message at 10:42 AM on 3 Aug: "gate kiosks offline at Vantorre's Hartford plant." You wrote that the guard was writing trailer numbers on a clipboard. The channel doesn't record anything else the guard did until 11:03 AM, when Mateo reported "Kiosk 1 is back. Guard checked in trailer 8836; dispatch sees it." Both lanes were back by 11:07 AM, per your 11:08 message.

There is an earlier entry on ticket SUP-5380 (Hartford gate kiosks offline, team-strategic): "08:12, Rebot failed; drivers queueing. Checking conn. now." The ticket doesn't say who wrote it, so I can't tell whether it counts as your report. If it was yours, the first report would be 08:12, and the guard's activity in that window isn't recorded anywhere I can see.
